verdict.rationale: The evidence never states a maximum number of concurrent sessions or requests for any pricing tier, nor any cost to raise such a cap. The SDK handling of 429 retries only implies rate limits exist. The max_credits ceiling is a user-set per-request spend guard, and the 10,000-row limit caps request size rather than concurrency; both are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap
